                                           FOUNDATION OF THE SAOSO STANDARDS
The IFOAM NORMS for Organic Production and Processing Version 2014. � IFOAM-Organics International,
October 2019 (Edited version of the IFOAM Norms 2014).

THE SOUTH AFRICAN ORGANIC SECTOR ORGANISATION (SAOSO) STANDARD FOR ORGANIC PRODUCTION AND
PROCESSING. VERSION 1.7 (JUNE, 2020).

                                         STANDARDS REFERENCED BY THIS STANDARD
COUNCIL REGULATION (EEC) No 2092/91 of 24 June 1991 on organic production of agricultural products and
indications referring thereto on agricultural products and foodstuffs.

REGULATION (EU) 2018/848 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 30 May 2018 on organic
production and labelling of organic products and repealing Council Regulation (EC) No 834/2007.

NATIONAL STANDARD OF CANADA. CAN/CGSB-32.310-2020. Organic production systems. General principles and
management standards.
